executive_summary: Over the past 24 hours, Israeli warplanes conducted flights over the Hermel and Akkar highlands in Lebanon. A UKMTO maritime security warning was issued for the region. A high-level travel advisory continues to urge against all travel to Lebanon amid ongoing security risks.

regional_sections.summary: Verified Official — UKMTO issued Maritime Security Warning 218-26.
Verified Official — Israeli warplanes flying over the Hermel and Akkar highlands.

advisory_highlights: Verified Official — Do not travel to Lebanon due to the volatile security situation, armed conflict, civil unrest and terrorism.
